results.summary: For $a\in\mathbb R/\mathbb Z$ and real $x>0$ the four one-variable kernels are each depends only on $a$ modulo $1$. They are real functions defined for every real $x$; only $x>0$ is used, where they are these sums. For $a,b\in\mathbb R/\mathbb Z$ the *theta kernel* of the shifted lattice $(a,b)+\mathbb Z^2$ and its *dual kernel* are the complex functions \theta^*_{a,b}(x)=S_a(x)C_b(x)+i\,C_a(x)S_b(x).$$

results.title: The completed lattice functions and their functional equation
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For $a,b\in\mathbb R/\mathbb Z$ let $\theta_{a,b}$ and $\theta^*_{a,b}$ be the theta kernels. The *completed lattice function* and its dual are the Mellin transforms \Lambda^*_{a,b}(s)=\int_0^\infty\theta^*_{a,b}(x)\,x^{s-1}\,dx\qquad(s\in\mathbb C),$$ each integral read as $0$ where the integrand is not integrable.
